title: OpenStax Calculus defines the derivative, in its section objective, as the limit of a difference quotient
summary: OpenStax Calculus defines the derivative, in its section objective, as the limit of a difference quotient.
body: OpenStax Calculus Volume 1, section 3.1, states as a learning objective that the reader define the derivative as the limit of a difference quotient, and that the reader distinguish average velocity from instantaneous velocity. The source says: "3.1.3 Identify the derivative as the limit of a difference quotient." The page opened is the section front matter, including that objective. The derivative is presented there as a limit, not as a symbol that can be manipulated without the limit existing. OpenStax books are openly licensed; this card reports the objective's wording.
